Bold and italic overlap without harm.

An unclosed paragraph is closed by the next one.

A div closes the paragraph before it.

* An item in a list that is never closed
* Another

  The stray end tag above closed nothing; this paragraph is still in the list.

* Item in a div

The div's end tag closed its list too.

Stray end tags: are ignored.

A lone end tag of a paragraph is an empty paragraph.

Cell still in the cell | next
After the table, still in the div.
